name: a01-the-vanishing-root
title: A01. The vanishing root
oracle: Empty visible root produces no plan, no trace and no ghost box.

name: a02-thirty-two-disappearing-intermediates
title: A02. Thirty-two disappearing intermediates
oracle: Omitting every hint creates exactly label → input; gaps do not accumulate.

name: a03-the-last-child-identity-trap
title: A03. The last-child identity trap
oracle: At all budgets the public edges remain avatar → identity and identity → actions.

name: a04-empty-groups-in-every-position
title: A04. Empty groups in every position
oracle: Empty leading, interior and trailing groups vanish before adjacency.

name: a05-singleton-is-still-a-compound
title: A05. Singleton is still a compound
oracle: A singleton identity does not export its title slot.

name: a06-errors-cannot-jump-fields
title: A06. Errors cannot jump fields
oracle: Only field → field crosses ownership; error → label must not exist.

name: a07-figure-dependency-done-structurally
title: A07. Figure dependency done structurally
oracle: Removing the figure removes its caption and credit as a subtree.

name: a08-orphan-caption-modelling-error
title: A08. Orphan-caption modelling error
oracle: The renderer must NOT invent dependency from slot names. A bare caption survives; this is an authoring counterexample.

name: a09-lost-execution-result
title: A09. Lost execution result
oracle: code → diagnostic is a genuine normal fallback after output omission.

name: a10-nested-optionality-is-conjunctive
title: A10. Nested optionality is conjunctive
oracle: A rank-0 descendant cannot escape an omitted rank-2 parent.

name: a11-host-override-of-required-content
title: A11. Host override of required content
oracle: Explicit hidden IDs override rank; the host, not layout, authorizes the operation.

name: a12-repeated-roles-are-not-repeated-identities
title: A12. Repeated roles are not repeated identities
oracle: Same-slot siblings retain distinct IDs, payloads, measurements, and owned edges.

name: a13-heading-direction-ladder
title: A13. Heading direction ladder
oracle: Reversed title/body pairs do not share binding.

name: a14-units-before-and-after
title: A14. Units before and after
oracle: unit → value and value → unit both exist; order and payload remain untouched.

name: a15-primary-is-not-generic-action
title: A15. Primary is not generic action
oracle: No slash-prefix inheritance. Only the exact primary/secondary and cancel/destructive pairs match.

name: a16-alien-slots-with-familiar-prefixes
title: A16. Alien slots with familiar prefixes
oracle: Unknown slots are valid; case folding and implicit ancestry are forbidden.

name: a17-danger-next-to-cancellation
title: A17. Danger next to cancellation
oracle: Separate the dangerous area, not the alternatives within its decision.

name: a18-no-blanket-warning-moat
title: A18. No blanket warning moat
oracle: Local error binding survives; unspecified error → retry stays fallback rather than guessed policy.

name: a19-copy-button-cannot-be-stranded
title: A19. Copy button cannot be stranded
oracle: Surplus width stays at row end; a tight copy action stays next to the value.

name: a20-the-kilometre-wide-weak-edge
title: A20. The kilometre-wide weak edge
oracle: The reference permits unbounded weak-edge stretch; record the consequence rather than inventing a maximum.

name: a21-two-stretchable-boundaries-compete
title: A21. Two stretchable boundaries compete
oracle: Spare space is divided by edge stretch weights, not put inside strong child boxes.

name: a22-huge-unbreakable-action-label
title: A22. Huge unbreakable action label
oracle: No-wrap button text may overflow even after a finite emergency singleton plan. Required content must not vanish.

name: a23-attached-does-not-mean-inviolable
title: A23. Attached does not mean inviolable
oracle: When no joint row fits, a finite attached cut is legal; hard keep is not in this grammar.

name: a24-avatar-squeezed-below-its-preferred-size
title: A24. Avatar squeezed below its preferred size
oracle: Both mandatory leaves survive. The host needs a minimum-size or overflow policy.

name: a25-zero-length-text-is-still-a-node
title: A25. Zero-length text is still a node
oracle: Empty payloads are not empty groups; preserve IDs, trace edges, and finite geometry.

name: a26-whitespace-and-hard-line-breaks
title: A26. Whitespace and hard line breaks
oracle: Preserve text payloads; remeasure actual height rather than character count.

name: a27-combining-marks-and-emoji-clusters
title: A27. Combining marks and emoji clusters

children.text: 漢字かな交じり文です。漢字かな交じり文です。漢字かな交じり文です。漢字かな交じり文です。漢字かな交じり文です。漢字かな交じり文です。漢字かな交じり文です。漢字かな交じり文です。漢字かな交じり文です。漢字かな交じり文です。

oracle: Exercise real shaping with mixed-script content; preserve DOM text/order. Pixel fit does not establish full language support.

name: a28-rtl-shell-with-ltr-identifiers
title: A28. RTL shell with LTR identifiers
oracle: Use logical adjacency/order; do not assume left-to-right physical coordinates.

name: a29-markup-is-text-never-executable
title: A29. Markup is text, never executable
oracle: No injected DOM elements or execution; exact literal payload survives.

name: a30-an-800-character-unbroken-reference
title: A30. An 800-character unbroken reference
oracle: Text wrapping and height must come from the backend, not an assumed preferred-width rectangle.

name: a31-text-at-twice-the-nominal-size
title: A31. Text at twice the nominal size

children.text: A short explanation that now takes more space.

oracle: The measured style epoch must match painted styles; do not reuse old dimensions.

name: a32-tall-primitive-beside-a-shallow-rail
title: A32. Tall primitive beside a shallow rail
oracle: Row height is max child height; block gaps refer to row boxes, not arbitrary leaf ink.

name: a33-one-leaf-versus-two-leaf-alignment-cliff
title: A33. One-leaf versus two-leaf alignment cliff
oracle: Omitting metadata can change the reference top/center heuristic; do not mistake fixed outer slots for fixed coordinates.

name: a34-strong-badge-run-under-pressure
title: A34. Strong badge run under pressure
oracle: No reordering, loss, or duplicated leaves under repeated tight edges.

name: a35-sixty-four-individually-owned-fields
title: A35. Sixty-four individually owned fields
oracle: Every field retains ownership and finite geometry; measure work, not just a screenshot.

name: a36-forty-action-flow
title: A36. Forty-action flow
oracle: Bounded stress workload for candidate growth; record planning time and memo states.

name: a37-twelve-alternating-singleton-wrappers
title: A37. Twelve alternating singleton wrappers
oracle: Wrappers preserve identity and contribute reference flow costs; arbitrary regrouping is NOT an invariance.

name: a38-nested-flow-looks-cheap-only-from-outside
title: A38. Nested flow looks cheap only from outside
oracle: Child plan costs feed into parent row decisions; a flat greedy breaker is not equivalent.

name: a39-alternating-weak-and-strong-cuts
title: A39. Alternating weak and strong cuts
oracle: A legal early weak cut can be better than filling the first row greedily.

name: a40-fractional-width-around-feasibility
title: A40. Fractional width around feasibility
oracle: Probe .01 quantization and .05 feasibility tolerance; do not assert arbitrary monotonicity.

name: a41-mandatory-content-at-one-pixel
title: A41. Mandatory content at one pixel
oracle: Finite planning is not visual fit. Preserve required content and surface limits.

name: a42-inputs-plus-appendages-at-minimum-width
title: A42. Inputs plus appendages at minimum width
oracle: Attached input/unit edges remain semantic; fixed padding may still exceed emergency allocations.

name: a43-empty-optional-action-area
title: A43. Empty optional action area
oracle: The empty actions group disappears; no trailing loose gap survives.

name: a44-public-slot-deliberately-disagrees-with-leaf
title: A44. Public slot deliberately disagrees with leaf
oracle: Use the public identity → actions edge, not a guessed warning wildcard.

name: a45-all-metadata-independent-paragraphs
title: A45. All metadata, independent paragraphs
oracle: A metadata → metadata rule applies locally at both levels without flattening the two owners.

name: a46-a-paragraph-full-of-giant-tokens
title: A46. A paragraph full of giant tokens
oracle: Long content can make a valid plan very tall; height is not in the reference objective.

name: a47-status-alternates-with-optional-summaries
title: A47. Status alternates with optional summaries
oracle: Every omission subset must resolve fresh adjacent pairs; exact/fallback provenance is observable.

name: a48-primitive-kind-and-role-are-independent
title: A48. Primitive kind and role are independent
oracle: Exercise all eight leaf kinds and both group layouts; a slot does not select primitive kind.

name: r01-discovered-zero-width-quantization-regression
title: R01. Discovered zero-width/quantization regression
